pool.spielzeit_stammkraft.e.e1: {b.gruss} {b.klage} I was a regular for a long time, and now nobody tells me why.
{b.gruss} {b.klage} It caught me by surprise, I thought I had my place here.
pool.spielzeit_stammkraft.e.e2: {b.gruss} {b.klage} I'd like to understand what has changed.
{b.gruss} {b.klage} Can you tell me where I stand?
pool.spielzeit_stammkraft.e.e3: {b.gruss} {b.klage} Honestly, I'm pretty wound up about it.
{b.gruss} {b.klage} It's eating at me, and I don't want it to get worse.
pool.spielzeit_stammkraft.e.e4: {b.gruss} {b.klage} I won't be left on the bench any longer without anyone saying a word!
{b.gruss} {b.klage} I want a clear answer now, or I don't know what I'll do.
pool.spielzeit_stammkraft.e.e5: {b.gruss} {b.klage} I don't want to moan, but I want to help the team and I can't from the bench.
{b.gruss} {b.klage} I trust you, I just don't understand it right now.
pool.spielzeit_stammkraft.e.e6: {b.gruss} {b.klage} I have goals, and I won't reach them from the sidelines.
{b.gruss} {b.klage} If this stays like it is, I'll have to think about my future.
pool.spielzeit_stammkraft.e.e7: {b.gruss} {b.klage} You promised me something, and so far nothing has happened.
{b.gruss} {b.klage} Do you remember your promise? I'm still waiting for it.
pool.spielzeit_stammkraft.a.a1: From next week you're back in the starting eleven, you can count on that. We'll talk again in {frist} days.
I'm planning you in again and will check it with you after {frist} days.
pool.spielzeit_stammkraft.a.a2: Let me explain how I pick the team: right now we need other things, and you're not out of the plan.
It isn't down to your class. The opponent and the fixture list shaped my decision.
pool.spielzeit_stammkraft.a.a3: Give me a few more games, then we'll see.
I know it isn't easy. Let's talk calmly after the next match.
pool.spielzeit_stammkraft.a.a4: I pick the team and that doesn't change. You'll have to live with it.
No. There's no guarantee of a place, not even for you.
pool.spielzeit_stammkraft.a.a5: I can see this hurts. I can offer you something to make it worthwhile, and we'll talk about your contract soon.
I want to meet you halfway: a bonus for the time on the bench, and you stay a firm part of the squad.
pool.spielzeit_stammkraft.a.a6: What do you think is the reason?
You tell me: where do you see yourself right now, and what are you missing?
pool.spielzeit_stammkraft.a.a7: I decide who plays, and I'm sticking to my line.
That's my decision. You'll get your chance when I think it's right.
pool.spielzeit_stammkraft.a.a8: I understand how that feels. You matter to us and I don't want you to feel put aside.
That must be hard, I was a substitute for a long time myself. You matter to us.
pool.spielzeit_stammkraft.a.a9: Please talk to the assistant, he has the figures from training. Then come to me.
The staff have the data from the past weeks. Go through where it's going wrong with him, then get back to me.
pool.spielzeit_stammkraft.a.a10: You get your role back, with a handshake. And if I forget, remind me in {frist} days.
Agreed: you're a regular again. Hold me to my word in {frist} days.
pool.spielzeit_stammkraft.r.r2: {b.gut} I know I can rely on you.
pool.spielzeit_stammkraft.r.r3: {b.gut} Then I'll give everything in training.
{b.gut} This is the chance I've been waiting for.
pool.spielzeit_stammkraft.r.r4: {b.neutral} Let's see what comes of it.
pool.spielzeit_stammkraft.r.r5: {b.neutral} I need to think about it, I don't know how I feel.
{b.neutral} That doesn't calm me yet, but I'm listening.
pool.spielzeit_stammkraft.r.r6: {b.schlecht} That's not how I imagined this talk.
pool.spielzeit_stammkraft.r.r7: {b.schlecht} So you're just telling me what I have to swallow?!
{b.schlecht} I'm sick of being treated like this!
pool.spielzeit_stammkraft.r.r8: {b.schlecht} There are other clubs who want me, and you know it.
{b.schlecht} Then I'll have to look around for something else.

pool.spielzeit_stammkraft.x.x2: The matter stays open. {entscheidung} He'll be back if nothing changes.

pool.spielzeit_stammkraft.r.r9: {b.neutral} I'll give it all a little more time.
